extraction.Name: John Cordier
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by R. E. Wang on June 18, 1918

extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612704 issued; south half of Northeast quarter and the North half of Southeast quarter, section 2, township 37, north of range 28; receipt for patent signed by allottee on February 9, 1918
